title: 第11章 败冯德英
slug: 修炼狂潮全本免费-修炼狂潮最新章节列表
content_zh:
“猛虎下山！”
他整个人气势汹汹，双拳摊开，犹如猛虎的上下颚，分别朝着楚云凡的头颅和胸口轰去。
冯德英的速度太快了，班上许多女生甚至都惊呼了出来，他们都看出来了，冯德英根本没有留手的打算，而这两拳打中了，以冯德英那分明已经是第九重的实力，后果简直不堪设想。
而留在这个时候，楚云凡抬起了双手，直接挡在了他的面前。
“啪！”
冯德英的双拳，居然被他挡住了。
却见楚云凡只是淡淡的一笑：“班长，我看你也太心急了！”
面对这并不算是公平的一战，他并无惧色，甚至相反的，隐隐还有些兴奋。
“没想到你居然挡得住我这一招，你这段时间有所进步，但是你以为因此就敢在我面前狂妄，你就大错特错了！”
冯德英冷笑一声，又是一步跨出，好似利箭一样的冲出，又是一拳犹如一杆长枪一样扫出，深谙快准狠的道理。
“冯德英，你这个人心胸狭窄，我不过是在早上反驳了你一下，你居然就这么针对我，你不是自诩天才么？”楚云凡大吼一声，“你修炼了好几个月，才只是修炼到登堂入室，也敢说自己是天才，我看根本就是是废物才对！”
说这，楚云凡也同样是双拳直接轰出，同样是虎魔拳。
与这冯德英，居然是同样的招式。
“嘭！”
“嘭！”
“嘭！”
双方直接展开了激烈的战斗，冯德英下手狠辣，快准备，深谙虎魔拳的精髓，这本来没什么，众人都知道，他家境富裕，早就请私教教过自己武学，这很正常。
不过更让众人惊讶的是，楚云凡居然处处与之针锋相对，不落下风。
而且所使用的虎魔拳，也是纯熟无比，非常流畅，丝毫都不比冯德英要差，这才是最让他们惊诧的。
要知道，楚云凡应该是第一次开始学虎魔拳，第一次学，仅仅只靠秦武演示的那几次，就算是记忆力超群，领悟力很强，最多也就是略懂皮毛罢了。

因为这些武技不是光的流畅。
这一点在楚云凡身上也有体现。
一开始的时候，楚云凡明显还有几分生涩，是身体还没有习惯打出虎魔拳，但是很快的，他就越打越流畅，就像是已经练习了好几个月一样。
楚云凡与冯德英两人交手的速度越来越快，也越来越激烈，短短几次呼吸之间，双方就直接撞了好几次。
很快，很多人就看出来了，楚云凡根本就是针对冯德英，不管冯德英用什么招式，他都同样用什么样的招式，以攻代守，居然也打的有声有色。
两人的下手都是同样的快准狠，在他们停留的间隙之间，众人分明看见，两人的手臂上，都已经充满了淤青，甚至还可以看到鲜血从其中渗透了出来。
这就是实战的凶险之处，哪怕不是生死对决，都容易弄的伤痕累累。
两人谁都没有占到便宜！
“这两人都好厉害！”
“最夸张的是楚云凡啊，居然真的能和班长打的不相上下！”
“我现在明白了，难怪穆振飞会失败了，根本就不是一个级别上的存在！”
“我没有看错吧，这楚云凡对于虎魔拳的领悟，居然不下于冯德英，难道他也之前学过么？”
“这根本不可能，他家里那么穷，到哪儿学去！”
场边，穆振飞看着场中的楚云凡，脸色一阵青一阵白，原本他还很不服气，觉得楚云凡也就是打了他一个措手不及，但是真正看到楚云凡和冯德英交手，他才发现，自己根本就想错了。
确实是有巨大的实力差距，哪怕是都是筋骨齐鸣的境界，但是差距就是差距，无从抵赖。
秦武在一旁看着交手的两人，眼神之中却是越发的闪亮了起来，却不是对着冯德英，而是对着楚云凡不断跃动的身影。
他没有想到，在自己教的学生之中，居然还出了一个这样的天才人物。
冯德英早就学过了虎魔拳，有登堂入室的境界不奇怪，但是楚云凡可是货真价实刚刚学的。
他的眼睛是何等的毒辣一眼就能够看得出来，楚云凡从一开始的还有些不习惯，到也能够施展出登堂入室境界的虎魔拳，也就花费了极短的时间就适应了。

content_en:
"The tiger is coming down the mountain!"
He was full of energy, with his fists spread out, like the upper and lower jaws of a tiger, striking at Chu Yunfan's head and chest respectively.
Feng Deying's speed was so fast that many girls in the class even screamed. They all saw that Feng Deying had no intention of holding back, and these two punches hit. With Feng Deying's strength, which was clearly the ninth level, the consequences were simply unimaginable.
At this moment, Chu Yunfan raised his hands and stood directly in front of him.
"Crack!"
Feng Deying's fists were actually blocked by him.
But Chu Yunfan just smiled faintly: "Squad leader, I think you are too impatient!"
Faced with the fact that this was not a fair battle, he was not afraid. On the contrary, he was even slightly excited.
"I didn't expect you to be able to block my move. You have made some progress during this time, but if you think that you dare to be arrogant in front of me because of this, you are totally wrong!"
Feng Deying sneered, took another step forward, rushed out like a sharp arrow, and swept out another punch like a spear. He knew the principles of speed, accuracy and ruthlessness.
"Feng Deying, you are a narrow-minded person. I just refuted you in the morning, but you actually targeted me like this. Don't you call yourself a genius?" Chu Yunfan yelled, "You have been practicing for several months, and you only have the courage to say that you are a genius. I think you are just a waste!"
Speaking of this, Chu Yunfan also punched out directly with both fists, also with the Tiger Demon Fist.
It's actually the same move as Feng Deying.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
The two sides immediately started a fierce battle. Feng Deying started fiercely and prepared quickly. He was well versed in the essence of Tiger Demon Fist. This was nothing at all. Everyone knew that he was from a wealthy family and had hired a private instructor to teach him martial arts. This was normal.
But what surprised everyone even more was that Chu Yunfan actually went head-to-head with him at every turn, never falling behind.
Moreover, the Tiger Demon Fist used was also extremely proficient and smooth, no worse than Feng Deying. This was what surprised them the most.
You know, it was probably the first time that Chu Yunfan started learning Tiger Demon Fist. The first time he learned it, he only relied on Qin Wu's demonstrations a few times. Even though he had an excellent memory and strong comprehension, he only had a superficial understanding at most.
Because these martial arts are not smooth and smooth.
This is also reflected in Chu Yunfan.
At the beginning, Chu Yunfan was obviously a bit raw because his body was not used to the Tiger Demon Fist, but soon, he became more and more fluent, as if he had been practicing for several months.
The fight between Chu Yunfan and Feng Deying became faster and faster, and became more and more intense. In just a few breaths, the two sides collided several times.
Soon, many people saw that Chu Yunfan was basically targeting Feng Deying. No matter what moves Feng Deying used, he also used the same moves, using offense instead of defense, and he actually fought effectively.
Both of them struck with the same speed and precision. During the gap between them, everyone could clearly see that their arms were already covered with bruises, and they could even see blood seeping out of them.
This is the dangerous part of actual combat. Even if it is not a life and death duel, it can easily result in scars.
Neither of them took advantage!
"These two are so awesome!"
"The most exaggerated thing is that Chu Yunfan can actually compete with the squad leader!"
"I understand now. No wonder Mu Zhenfei failed. He is not on the same level at all!"
"Am I right? Chu Yunfan's understanding of Tiger Demon Fist is no less than that of Feng Deying. Has he also learned it before?"
"This is impossible. His family is so poor, where can he go to school?"
On the sidelines, Mu Zhenfei looked at Chu Yunfan on the court, his face turning green and white. Initially, he was still unconvinced and felt that Chu Yunfan was alsoIt caught him off guard, but when he actually saw Chu Yunfan and Feng Deying fighting, he realized that he had been thinking wrong.
There is indeed a huge gap in strength, even if they are both in the same state of strength, but the gap is a gap and cannot be denied.
Qin Wu looked at the two people fighting from the side, his eyes shining more and more, not towards Feng Deying, but towards Chu Yunfan's constantly jumping figure.
He did not expect that among the students he taught, there would be such a genius.
Feng Deying had learned Tiger Demon Fist a long time ago, so it was not surprising that he was in the realm of entering a palace, but Chu Yunfan had just learned it for real.
You can see how vicious his eyes are at a glance. Chu Yunfan was a little unaccustomed to it at the beginning, but it took him a very short time to adapt to the fact that he was able to perform the Tiger Demon Fist, which is at the level of entering the palace.
